```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(framework)
scaffold()
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false

# One query per slide is fine for a talk; cache_remember() keeps re-renders
# fast while you edit the slides. Delete cache/ to force fresh numbers.
visits <- cache_remember("visits_with_arm", db_query(
  "SELECT v.participant_id, v.visit_number, v.systolic_bp, p.treatment, s.site_name
   FROM visits v
   JOIN participants p ON p.participant_id = v.participant_id
   JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = p.site_id",
  "study"
))

n_participants <- db_query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM participants", "study")$n
```

## Where we are

- `r n_participants` participants at four clinics, randomized 1:1
- `r format(nrow(visits))` visits recorded so far
- Primary outcome: systolic blood pressure

## Systolic pressure by visit

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
sbp_by_visit <- visits |>
  group_by(treatment, visit_number) |>
  summarise(mean_systolic = mean(systolic_bp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(sbp_by_visit, aes(visit_number, mean_systolic, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Visit", y = "Mean systolic pressure (mmHg)", colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 16))
```

## By clinic, at each participant's last visit

```{r}
last_visit <- visits |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  filter(visit_number == max(visit_number)) |>
  ungroup()

last_visit |>
  group_by(site_name, treatment) |>
  summarise(mean_systolic = round(mean(systolic_bp, na.rm = TRUE), 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mean_systolic) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Clinic", "Control", "Intervention"))
```
